name: 2D Gaussian Accumulation (Batched)
definition: A helper function that computes the accumulated color, alpha, and normal contributions for a batch of 2D Gaussians intersecting specific pixels, using nerfacc for ray accumulation.
summary: 2D Gaussian Accumulation (Batched) composites pre-computed alpha values of 2D Gaussians onto the image plane using the nerfacc library for efficient batched ray accumulation.
